# M19-S2: elastic background marking follows the collector mode of the build.
# logos defaults to greentea, which paces elastically; go -gc=greentea selects
# the same pacing explicitly; plain go with no -gc paces elastically as the
# production default. Every other mode keeps the upstream pacing (G3). The
# helper starts two collections by hand with
# GODEBUG=gcpacertrace=1; a cycle start under elastic pacing prints a
# "pacer: elastic" line before the upstream "pacer: assist ratio" line.
# GODEBUG is set around each run only, so the go command itself does not
# print pacer lines.

# The helper runs real collections on the host, which a short or a wasm run
# cannot do; on GOARCH=wasm logos selects the wasm mode, not greentea.
[short] skip
[GOARCH:wasm] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# logos with no flag: greentea, elastic. A heap far below its goal runs at the
# floor of the curve, a quarter of the Ps.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/logos_default$GOEXE .
env GODEBUG=gcpacertrace=1
exec $WORK/bin/logos_default$GOEXE
env GODEBUG=
stdout '^done$'
stderr 'pacer: elastic u=\S+ util=0\.25 workers=\d+\+\S+'
stderr 'pacer: assist ratio='

# go -gc=greentea: the same pacing for a Go package.
go build -gc=greentea -o $WORK/bin/go_greentea$GOEXE .
env GODEBUG=gcpacertrace=1
exec $WORK/bin/go_greentea$GOEXE
env GODEBUG=
stdout '^done$'
stderr 'pacer: elastic u=\S+ util=0\.25 workers=\d+\+\S+'
stderr 'pacer: assist ratio='

# logos -gc=greentea names the default and changes nothing.
logos build -gc=greentea -o $WORK/bin/logos_greentea$GOEXE .
env GODEBUG=gcpacertrace=1
exec $WORK/bin/logos_greentea$GOEXE
env GODEBUG=
stderr 'pacer: elastic u='

# go with no -gc paces elastically as the production default: the trace shows
# the elastic line beside the assist line.
go build -o $WORK/bin/go_default$GOEXE .
env GODEBUG=gcpacertrace=1
exec $WORK/bin/go_default$GOEXE
env GODEBUG=
stdout '^done$'
stderr 'pacer: elastic u=\S+ util=0\.25 workers=\d+\+\S+'
stderr 'pacer: assist ratio='

# Another mode keeps the upstream pacing.
go build -gc=batch -o $WORK/bin/go_batch$GOEXE .
env GODEBUG=gcpacertrace=1
exec $WORK/bin/go_batch$GOEXE
env GODEBUG=
stdout '^done$'
stderr 'pacer: assist ratio='
! stderr 'pacer: elastic'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/gcpacing

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
)

func main() {
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.GC()
	fmt.Println("done")
}
